text.p: Ticketmaster Group Inc plans to offer 7.25 million shares in an estimated range of $13 to $15 each in its proposed initial public offering, according to documents filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday.
The company had not specified any terms when it first filed for the IPO in September.
The offering, lead managed by Allen & Co, is tentatively scheduled to make its market debut on November 11, with shares trading on the Nasdaq under the symbol "TKTM".

All of the shares will be offered by the company in the offering. After the IPO, principal shareholders and their affiliates will hold about 68.3 percent of the outstanding common shares of Ticketmaster, according to the filing.
Ticketmaster, headquartered in Los Angeles, Calif., is provides automated ticketing services for entertainment events
